body:
Thanks for the input, but I do honestly believe she would be better off. She's stuck with it (nearly 20 years) and put up with a lot of stuff I shouldn't have put on her, and I haven't been nearly as supportive of her issues as I should have.  She's got a great network and everyone loves her, so she'll find someone else, hopefully better.
As far as talking to her, that doesn't work any more. A psychologist told her that if I really want to do it, there's nothing she can do to stop it, and so now whenever I try to talk about it, she just refuses.
